description.value: Pita Pit is a Canadian fast-casual chain serving customizable pita sandwiches, salads, and rice bowls made to order. This Christina Lake location on McGregor Frontage Road sits along a key corridor for cyclists riding through the Boundary region. Smoothies are confirmed available at this location, and both takeout and delivery ordering are offered.

address.value: 1590 McGregor Frontage Road, Christina Lake, V0H 1E0
